objective: Improve universal agent quality and final CSV under the existing constraints; retain the strongest verified controls
authorization: Existing user permission; prepare these experiments, then return to the active automatic research objective
execution_policy: Sequential after actual current terminal and fresh owned/bootstrap/preparer closure, canonical lock, published source and declared gates. No new clock or job is started by this queue file.

observed_scope.implemented_linear_scope: Existing linear_text supports numeric median/scaling, categorical OHE, Ridge(alpha10) and LogisticRegression/SGD even without text columns; dedicated tabular engine names and mandatory portfolio admission are absent.
observed_scope.metadata_note: Metadata lookup only, no import or availability test. All are allowed by original requirements; missing local distributions are not implemented ready tools.

common_quality_rules.regression: Lower RMSE; preserve forward offsets0/1/2 for component screens
common_quality_rules.classification: Higher all-class MacroF1 on fixed group cuts42/43, supported-class loss and ex-rarest gates retained
common_quality_rules.complete_control: Saved V11/V16, regression35.4472315578 and classification0.6593178434. Best verified regression component T5=34.8662208787 retained. Fresh weaker control cannot manufacture a historical win.
common_quality_rules.component_vs_procedure: Component controls and whole-agent control are different units. Screens do not promote a whole pipeline; promising components require complete agent/refit/CSV/integrity/source/exact gates.
common_quality_rules.failure: Keep timeouts/OOM/errors/absent CSV as explicit null failures, never objective0; preserve original clocks and all receipts
common_quality_rules.scope: Reused-public research only, not private/official score

experiments.name: ExtraTrees family and complementary predictions
experiments.hypothesis: A randomized forest can add errors different from boosting; diversity may help a fixed blend even when its standalone score is weaker.
experiments.factor: One new learner with its necessary supported preprocessing; no sampling/weight/feature-policy change is credited as a pure model effect
experiments.plan: Component screen on3forward regression+2group classification cuts. Fit protected component controls and candidate on identical saved fitting rows; retain all aligned probabilities/predictions for METH-03. Existing ExtraTrees adapter first, no new dependency.
experiments.after_screen: No mandatory full-agent queue inclusion unless measured contribution passes the declared downstream gates; keep negative standalone result even if later blend helps.
experiments.fixed_weight_scope: Inherited same power.5 as all3 strong class-control components; no tuned weight experiment

experiments.name: Enable and audit existing tabular Ridge/LogisticRegression path
experiments.hypothesis: Regularized linear models may generalize under temporal shift or add complementary class probabilities while costing less than another boosting fit.
experiments.fitting_contract: Use the existing fitting-only numeric finite conversion/median imputation/scaling plus sparse OneHot(handle_unknown=ignore,min_frequency3). First verify no-text input, unknown category, fitting-scope, finite/class-order outputs and measured resource bounds. Do not rewrite an existing path just because its engine name says text.
experiments.outputs: Exact rows/ID/schema; regression inverse target transform if explicitly used; class order aligned to declared classes, finite normalized probabilities and all-class F1. Unknown/missing fitting class is an explicit contract outcome, never silently removed.
experiments.screen: One preregistered regularization setting per task first, same saved cuts/controls. Hyperparameter tuning only after the standalone tool contract and basic measured cost are known.
experiments.implementation_change_first: Admission/source fixture only; no new model implementation until an actual missing contract or failure is established.

experiments.name: Fixed weak-model blend contribution
experiments.hypothesis: A different family can improve the strong ensemble through complementary predictions, despite a weaker standalone metric.
experiments.factor: A single predeclared blend, no validation-guided weight grid or selecting weights separately by cut
experiments.requires: Independently verified same-partition/source/row/class aligned component caches and pristine labels. Examine every declared cut/support gate. Positive component result still needs later real full refits and whole-agent qualification.

experiments.name: Task-selected method skills in Qwen context
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit task-appropriate instructions about actually implemented methods improve Qwen proposals and reduce attempts at unavailable tools or inappropriate preprocessing.
experiments.factor: Only bounded method_skills context field; portfolio, objective, HPO and worker behavior unchanged
experiments.implementation: Opt-in --method-skills source overlay selects bounded instructions by task kind/text and trusted runtime CAPABILITIES, before initial/followup requests. Default-OFF AST projection matches base. This is embedded instruction retrieval, not a claim that Qwen already reads arbitrary SKILL.md files.
experiments.fairness: Both OFF/ON full messages pass same shared byte/resource preflight; same frozen context/model/reasoning/configuration, remove added field to recover OFF. Record invalid/duplicates/null/timeouts/costs.
experiments.then: Only promising generation findings advance to separate matched full-agent A/B at equal10800s per arm, common pair21600 including gates/refit/CSV/audits. Proposal validity alone is not an ML gain.
experiments.scope_limitation: No runner integration, exact release, Qwen generation or ML quality evidence yet.

experiments.name: Conditional portfolio by fitting properties and measured budget
experiments.hypothesis: Allocating scarce candidate slots according to data properties and observed fit cost outperforms always running the same family list.
experiments.factor: Fixed expanded portfolio versus preregistered conditional admission, with same max candidates/API/HPO/common budget and unchanged protected control
experiments.inputs: Task kind, fitting-only numeric/categorical/text/cardinality/missingness properties and measured cost. No holdout labels or official scores; freeze thresholds before outcomes.

experiments.name: Nested AutoML or small CPU neural model feasibility
experiments.hypothesis: A separately bounded AutoML or small neural candidate may supply useful diversity; nested search overhead may also exhaust the budget without helping.
experiments.initial_work: Inspect allowed API and isolated environment compatibility; no change to the active venv. First prove CPU/thread/memory/deadline/output contracts, then preregister a small candidate screen. Never advertise a missing or untested tool to Qwen as ready.
experiments.restrictions: No runtime package install, pretrained weights, external training data, paid compute or GPU. No nested unlimited HPO. Full fit/search/export costs count in the same experiment budget.
